creatormotion_faq_1_a: A-roll is your main footage, usually you talking to the camera. B-roll is everything you cut to while you keep talking: charts, screen recordings, diagrams and other visuals that show what you are saying. CreatorMotion makes motion graphics for both: 24 effects that work on your talking-head shot, 89 explainer clips you cut away to, and 9 chapter cards and transitions.
creatormotion_faq_1_q: What is the difference between A-roll and B-roll?
creatormotion_faq_2_a: In CapCut or Premiere Pro you duplicate the clip, remove the background on the top copy and place the text layer between the two. With CreatorMotion, ask your agent for Title Behind Subject and give it your clip: it cuts you out of the shot automatically and sets the title between you and the background. The free Title Scene Takeover also puts a title behind you, then cuts to it full screen.
creatormotion_faq_2_q: How do I put text behind a person in a video?
creatormotion_faq_3_a: Claude Code won't edit your whole video, but it can make the motion graphics in it. With CreatorMotion installed, Claude Code, Codex or Cursor turns a script line, your numbers or a clip of you into a short motion graphics clip and renders it as an MP4. You then import that MP4 into CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or any other editor and place it on your timeline.
creatormotion_faq_3_q: Can Claude AI do video editing?
creatormotion_faq_4_a: Yes. Every effect renders to a standard MP4 in 4K, 2K or 1080p. Import it like any other clip in CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro and place it on your B-roll track.
creatormotion_faq_4_q: Does it work with CapCut, Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve?
creatormotion_faq_5_a: Yes. Every effect has its own native 9:16 and 3:4 layout, with the bottom of the frame kept clear for your captions and the platform’s buttons.
creatormotion_faq_5_q: Can I make vertical videos for TikTok, Reels and Shorts?
creatormotion_faq_6_a: No. Effects are generated on your own machine with Node.js, FFmpeg and the open-source HyperFrames CLI, with no paid API calls. The CreatorMotion bundle with all 122+ effects comes with Skillry Pro; single effects can also be bought once, and two are free to try.
creatormotion_faq_6_q: Do I pay for an API or a subscription per video?
creatormotion_faq_7_a: CreatorMotion builds HyperFrames projects: plain HTML, CSS and GSAP animation that render to MP4, so your agent can read and change every title, number and color. You do not need Remotion to use it.
creatormotion_faq_7_q: Remotion vs HyperFrames: what does CreatorMotion use?
creatormotion_faq_8_a: No. CapCut is a full editor; CreatorMotion makes the motion graphics you drop into it. Keep editing in CapCut, Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve and let your agent build the explainer moments.

launchmotion_faq_1_a: A product launch video is a short film, usually 30 to 90 seconds, that introduces something new: what it is, what it does and why it matters now. Teams post it on X, LinkedIn and Product Hunt and pin it to the launch page.
launchmotion_faq_1_q: What is a product launch video?
launchmotion_faq_2_a: Most land between 30 and 60 seconds. For X and LinkedIn, aim for 30 to 45 seconds with the product on screen in the first three. LaunchMotion scenes run 7 to 14 seconds, so four to six scenes make a full launch film.
launchmotion_faq_2_q: How long should a product launch video be?
launchmotion_faq_3_a: Install LaunchMotion, then describe the launch to your agent: the product, the one line that matters, a number and your logo. The agent storyboards one scene per beat, rewrites the copy, renders each scene and joins them into one MP4 with music.
launchmotion_faq_3_q: How do I make a product launch video with AI?
launchmotion_faq_4_a: Yes. Every line on screen is a text slot, and image and logo slots take your files. Scenes that show AI tools use their real logos by default; swap in yours when you feature your own product, from an app promo video to a brand launch video.
launchmotion_faq_4_q: Can I use my own logo, screenshots and product name?
launchmotion_faq_5_a: Yes, if you want it. Bring your own track, or set ELEVENLABS_API_KEY or FAL_KEY and the Skill generates an instrumental bed after asking you. It plays as one continuous piece and dips under any voiceover.
launchmotion_faq_6_a: Yes. Each of the 208 motion graphics templates is its own Skill for $4.99. The full LaunchMotion library, with the agent workflow that picks and joins scenes, comes with Skillry Pro.
launchmotion_faq_6_q: Can I buy one scene instead of the whole library?
launchmotion_faq_7_a: An MP4 for each scene, up to 4K, and for the joined film, plus the editable HyperFrames project behind it, so you can change a line and render again.
launchmotion_faq_8_a: Not in the usual sense. It does not generate footage from a prompt. Your agent builds each shot from designed scenes and your own screenshots, so the product on screen is the real one and every render matches the preview.

mcp_docs_auth: Account calls use browser authorization with skills:read. The current credential expires after 7 days and has no automatic renewal. CLI and MCP on the same computer share the credential for the same service URL; disconnecting revokes that credential.
mcp_docs_description: Reference for Skillry MCP's 12 tools: search filters, browser authorization, downloads, installation targets and safe updates.
mcp_docs_example_note: Replace <skill-slug> with a slug returned by search_skills and <published-version> with the selected release version. Use absolute paths for your own computer.
mcp_docs_intro: Use these tools from a connected MCP client. Your agent usually supplies the arguments; this reference is for inspecting calls and building integrations.
mcp_docs_no_parameters: No arguments. Pass an empty object.
mcp_docs_param_agent: Installation target, not the MCP host name. Global targets use their configured Skills directory. Project scope accepts shared or claude-code only.
mcp_docs_param_allowApiKeys: Set false to exclude declared required provider keys. Missing declarations remain unknown.
mcp_docs_param_allowExternalCosts: Set false to exclude declared external costs. Unknown costs still need review.
mcp_docs_param_avoidVoiceover: Set true to exclude known core voiceover requirements.
mcp_docs_param_deliveryScope: Select a complete work or a component. Missing delivery metadata stays subject to review.
mcp_docs_param_downloadDirectory: Explicit absolute directory for saving the ZIP. No agent or installation scope is used.
mcp_docs_param_expectedVersion: Selected published version. Required for updates; optional for installation/download. A changed release must be reviewed before continuing.
mcp_docs_param_limit: Maximum results per call. Use the range and default shown for this tool.
mcp_docs_param_locale: Content language. Use the exact API locale value, including zh-CN, zh-TW and pt-BR.
mcp_docs_param_offset: Pagination offset. Continue with the returned nextOffset.
mcp_docs_param_outputType: Filter by the desired output type. presentation is the API value for presentation Skills.
mcp_docs_param_projectDirectory: Absolute project path, required with scope: project and disallowed with scope: global. shared uses .agents/skills; claude-code uses .claude/skills.
mcp_docs_param_query: Desired output or exact name/slug. Describe the result you want; an input PDF or URL does not define the output type.
mcp_docs_param_scope: global installs for your OS user. project installs under the explicit projectDirectory.
mcp_docs_param_slug: Exact published Skill slug selected by the user; lowercase kebab-case, up to 64 characters.
mcp_docs_paths_body: Global shared, codex, cursor, gemini-cli, opencode and kimi-code use ~/.agents/skills. claude-code uses ~/.claude/skills. antigravity uses ~/.gemini/config/skills. Project scope uses <projectDirectory>/.agents/skills or <projectDirectory>/.claude/skills. Never infer a project from the MCP process working directory.
mcp_docs_recovery_access_body: Follow the returned purchaseUrl/actionUrl for purchase_required or premium_required. For daily_download_limit, show resetsAt. Repeated downloads of the same Skill that day do not use another distinct-Skill slot; the day resets at 00:00 UTC.
mcp_docs_recovery_auth_body: For authentication_required or session_expired, ask the user to connect, call connect_account, show its URL/code and poll connection_status at the specified interval. Retry the original action after approval.
mcp_docs_recovery_exists_body: For skill_already_installed, inspect the same target with list_installed_skills and check_updates. Ask before updating a managed installation to a selected newer release. MCP has no force argument.
mcp_docs_recovery_setup_body: Check Node.js 22+, the selected OS configuration and client logs. Restart or reload the client after adding the server. Browser-only or Linux environments are outside the current supported setup.
mcp_docs_result_account_status: Returns connected, entitlement, scope, sessionExpiresAt, quota and pricingUrl. Personal identity and credentials are omitted.
mcp_docs_result_check_updates: Returns current, update_available, unavailable or unmanaged for each entry, plus nextOffset. Use the same agent and scope when continuing.
mcp_docs_result_connect_account: Returns verificationUrl, userCode, expiresAt, browserOpened and pollAfterSeconds. Show the URL and matching code to the user; credentials are never returned.
mcp_docs_result_connection_status: Reports not_started, pending, denied, expired or connected. After approval, the token is saved in the OS keyring. Respect the polling interval.
mcp_docs_result_disconnect_account: Inspect serverRevoked. If remote revocation fails, the local credential is removed but the server token may remain usable until expiry.
mcp_docs_result_download_skill: Returns archivePath, slug, version and sha256 after ZIP integrity and release checks. Does not install or report an installation.
mcp_docs_result_get_skill: Returns public release metadata. It does not grant access or include private package contents.
mcp_docs_result_get_skill_access: Returns access (free, purchased, member or purchase_required), canDownload, reason, purchaseUrl, version and quota. Download checks permissions again.
mcp_docs_result_install_skill: Returns targetPath, skillFile, version, completionReported and inventoryRecorded. Read SKILL.md and review costs before running it.
mcp_docs_result_list_installed_skills: Returns local entries and their managed/version status. Unmanaged Skills have unknown versions and cannot be silently upgraded.
mcp_docs_result_search_skills: Returns skills, nextOffset and retrieval/review status. Inspect appliedRequirements, requirementReview, costNotice and clarificationQuestion. Unknown requirements need review; constraintsStatus: unconfirmed means the service did not confirm enforcement. Scores are not probabilities.
mcp_docs_result_update_skill: Returns the installed release and backupPath when a replacement occurs. An already current version is returned without replacement.
mcp_docs_selection: Inspect requirements and access before installing. Keep the user's selected Skill and version. Installation never executes the Skill, purchases access or pays an external provider.
mcp_docs_tool_account_status: Check current membership, authorization expiry, scope and daily download quota.
mcp_docs_tool_check_updates: Compare local managed installations with published releases. Checking does not download or install an update.
mcp_docs_tool_connect_account: Start browser account authorization when the user asks to connect. An already pending flow is reused.
mcp_docs_tool_connection_status: Continue a pending authorization flow. Call again after the returned pollAfterSeconds interval.
mcp_docs_tool_disconnect_account: Cancel pending authorization, revoke the shared CLI/MCP credential and remove it from the OS keyring.
mcp_docs_tool_download_skill: Save a verified Skill ZIP in a chosen absolute download directory. Existing files are never overwritten.
mcp_docs_tool_get_skill: Inspect one published Skill's version, preview link, inputs, dependencies and external costs before making a selection.
mcp_docs_tool_get_skill_access: Check access to one published Skill before downloading. This check does not reserve or consume a quota slot.
mcp_docs_tool_install_skill: Install the selected release into an explicitly chosen agent and scope. Existing Skill directories are not overwritten.
mcp_docs_tool_list_installed_skills: Read Skills in the selected local directory. Only Skillry-managed installations have a recorded release version.
mcp_docs_tool_search_skills: Find published Skills by the output you want and explicit requirements. Default retrieval uses keywords; matching does not guarantee that a Skill can run in your setup.
mcp_docs_tool_update_skill: Update a Skillry-managed Skill installed on your computer to the version explicitly approved by the user. Back up the entire previous directory, including local edits.
mcp_docs_transport: Skillry uses a local stdio server on macOS or Windows with Node.js 22+. Credentials stay in the OS keyring. The website URL /mcp is a setup page, not a remote MCP endpoint.

skills_home_faq_agents_answer: The catalog works with agents that can read and install Agent Skills. Start with the supported examples on this page, then follow your agent's normal Skill installation flow.
skills_home_faq_agents_question: Will this work with my Agent?
skills_home_faq_api_key_answer: Connecting Skillry MCP or CLI needs no Skillry API key. Approve account access in your browser; credentials are stored in the OS keyring. Some image or video Skills require your own provider key and external fees. Check the Skill's requirements before running it.
skills_home_faq_api_key_question: Do I need an API key?
skills_home_faq_description: The essentials for choosing, installing, and using your first Skill.
skills_home_faq_formats_answer: Skills cover focused work across Slides, Web, Images, and Video. Each Skill page explains the result it helps your agent create before you install it.
skills_home_faq_formats_question: What kinds of work can Skills help with?
skills_home_faq_maker_answer: Our own team. Every Skill is designed, written and tested in-house, from the example on its page to the templates and scripts inside the package, and we keep updating it after release.
skills_home_faq_maker_question: Who makes the Skills on Skillry?
skills_home_faq_start_answer: Browse the catalog, choose a Skill and use its install prompt or ZIP download. You can also connect Skillry MCP to search and inspect Skills from your agent. Authorize your account in the browser to install; your agent runs the installed workflow.
skills_home_faq_updates_answer: With MCP, ask your agent to check installed Skills for updates, then approve the selected version before upgrading; the previous directory is preserved as a backup. With the terminal CLI, explicitly reinstall using --force, or download the latest ZIP from the Skill page.
skills_home_faq_updates_question: How do I get Skill updates?
skills_home_faq_what_answer: A Skill is a reusable set of instructions and resources that helps an AI agent complete a specific kind of work.

skills_pricing_faq_auth_answer: No Skillry API key is required. Approve the connection in your browser. Individual Skills may require keys for external providers; check their dependencies and costs before running.
skills_pricing_faq_auth_question: Do I need an API key to connect?
skills_pricing_faq_cancel_answer: You can cancel a Monthly or Yearly subscription whenever you need. Your Premium access continues until the end of the current billing period.
skills_pricing_faq_cancel_question: Can I cancel a subscription anytime?
skills_pricing_faq_costs_answer: Your plan covers access to Skills. Your agent runs them on your own setup. External model, API and rendering charges are separate; check the Skill page before running it.
skills_pricing_faq_costs_question: Does my plan include model or rendering costs?
skills_pricing_faq_description: Straight answers about plans, billing, and what stays included.
skills_pricing_faq_free_answer: You can browse and search the catalog without signing in. Sign in to install free Skills. Paid Skills require the relevant purchase or membership.
skills_pricing_faq_free_question: What can I use for free?
skills_pricing_faq_mcp_answer: Yes. Connect Skillry MCP to search published Skills and inspect their requirements from your agent. Authorize your account in the browser to download or install. Paid Skills require the relevant purchase or membership.
skills_pricing_faq_mcp_question: Can I use Skillry through MCP?
skills_pricing_faq_payment_answer: Choose the plan that fits you, then complete checkout securely. After payment succeeds, Premium access is added to the account you used at checkout.
skills_pricing_faq_payment_question: How does payment and access work?
skills_pricing_faq_plans_answer: Monthly and Yearly give you Premium access while your subscription is active. Founding Lifetime is a single payment for ongoing Premium access at a price that increases as the library grows.
skills_pricing_faq_plans_question: How do Monthly, Yearly, and Founding Lifetime differ?
skills_pricing_faq_renewal_answer: Monthly and Yearly renew at the end of each billing period until you cancel. Founding Lifetime has no subscription or renewal charge.
skills_pricing_faq_updates_answer: All three paid plans include updates and newly published Premium Skills while your access remains active. Free Skills stay free. With MCP, ask your agent to check for updates and approve an update before it is installed.
skills_pricing_faq_updates_question: Are updates and new Skills included?
